Needs changes before merge.

I reviewed this head locally against upstream main `6f8b309dcea9ea2c367ecfa53261ed140881bab3`. The trial merge needed no changes. Main is already an ancestor of this head. No GitHub runner was used.

The demo loads, verifies, and posts without warnings. Its posted output matches the project built by the test commands. The guide links resolve. No production safety code, UI code, dependencies, or build scripts changed. No existing golden files moved. I used the safety review checks because the PR adds model geometry and a machining example.

Local results:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | Pass; all app test targets built |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Pass; both `first_router_part` tests passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Pass |
| `ZOLA=<local binary> python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_navigation.py -v` | Pass; 5 tests, including the Zola build and internal link checks |
| Guide CLI command, with output under `/tmp` | Pass; 3 operations, no warnings, no gate problems |
| `cargo test -p xtask gate_maps_tests::no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app -- --exact` | Fail; 0 passed, 1 failed |

Zola was version 0.23.6. Its archive checksum matched the upstream release workflow.

The Gate map check failed with:

```text
suites without a Gate map: ["first_router_part"]
```

I repeated two of the PR's mutation checks:

- Remove `examples/first-router-part.camproj`: the project test failed on the missing file. Restore it: the test passed.
- Remove `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-router-part.md`: the guide test failed on the missing page. Restore it: the test passed.

Requested changes:

1. **Correct the RichAuto X/Y zero instruction.** `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-router-part.md:165` tells the operator to press `ORIGIN` to zero X/Y. On the A11, `ORIGIN/OK` returns to the existing work origin. It does not set that origin. This can cause an unexpected move and leave the wrong work offset active. Use the `XY→0` key instruction. Add the OEM manual citation required by issue #1917. The [RichAuto A11 manual](https://www.richautocontroller.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/DSP-A11-Manual.pdf), sections 2.3 and 5.4.1, identifies these separate functions.

2. **Add the missing Gate map.** `crates/app/tests/first_router_part.rs:1` has no `Gate map:` header. The existing xtask test rejects this new suite. Add a map for the modules that the suite tests, using their owning crates. Then run the map check again. This also lets later module changes select the demo test.

3. **State the drill breakthrough depth.** `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-router-part.md:39` says the cutting depth stops at `-12 mm`. The supplied demo posts `G73 X53 Y50 Z-13 R0 Q4 F150`. The drill goes 1 mm below the 12 mm stock. State this depth in the drilling instructions and include it in the spoilboard and fastener clearance check at line 99. The current text can lead a reader to check clearance only to the stock bottom.

No physical machine test was done. There are no UI changes that require before/after screenshots.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the three requested changes.

1. The A11 instructions now use `XY→0` to set X/Y zero. They explain `ORIGIN/OK` and cite OEM manual sections 2.3 and 5.4.1. Pin: `first_router_part_richauto_zeroing_uses_xy0_with_oem_source`.
2. The demo suite now has a Gate map with the owning crates. Pin: `gate_maps_tests::no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app`.
3. The setup, drilling instructions, and clearance check now state the `-13 mm` drill depth. This includes spoilboard and fastener clearance. Pins: `first_router_part_guide_states_drill_breakthrough_and_clearance` and `first_router_part_project_loads_verifies_and_posts_to_grblhal`.

All four demo tests pass. Eight independent mutations failed as expected. Each test passed after restoration. The Gate map check passes.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passes. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.

New head: `a6e9bb8601408ca61e0c1c97a0686ac79dd0c957`.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

I reviewed this head locally after a clean trial merge with upstream main `d1484f02a359eb496803630f36575897a88f75ee`. No GitHub runner was used.

The three requests from the previous review are complete:

- The guide uses `XY→0` to set X/Y zero. It explains the separate `ORIGIN/OK` function and cites the [RichAuto A11 OEM manual](https://www.richautocontroller.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/DSP-A11-Manual.pdf), sections 2.3 and 5.4.1.
- The new test suite has a Gate map. The map check passes.
- The setup, drilling, and clearance instructions state the `-13 mm` drill depth. They include the spoilboard and fasteners.

Local results:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --no-run` | Pass; all app test targets built |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Pass; all 4 `first_router_part` tests passed |
| `cargo test -p xtask gate_maps_tests::no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app -- --exact` | Pass; 1 test passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Pass |
| `ZOLA=<local binary> python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_navigation.py -v` | Pass; 5 tests, including the Zola build and internal link checks |
| Guide CLI command, with output under `/tmp` | Pass; 3 operations, no warnings, no verification problems |

Zola was version 0.23.6. The project test confirms that the saved demo and the command-built demo post the same output.

I used the safety review checks because the PR adds demo geometry and machining instructions. Production posting, collision, gouge, and stock simulation code did not change. No existing golden files changed. I read the generated 188-line NC program and checked the operation order, drill depth, pocket depth, and contour tab moves.

I repeated two of the PR's mutation checks:

- Remove `examples/first-router-part.camproj`: the project test failed on the missing file. Restore the file: the test passed.
- Remove `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-router-part.md`: the guide test failed on the missing page. Restore the file: the test passed.

Both files match the reviewed versions after restoration.

Requested changes: none.

No physical machine test was done. No `crates/ui` files changed, so before/after UI screenshots are not required.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
